method: WebFetch per URL (plus WebSearch to locate specific track pages where the manifest URL was a catalog/landing page)

ruleset.hard_rule: If a row's license cannot be confirmed on a WebFetch-reachable page, leave verification_status='pending' with last_check_at + last_check_note. Never fabricate 'verified'.

entries.notes: FMA artist page returned client_error on two attempts in-session (rate-limit behavior). WebSearch found that Kai Engel's 'Idea' lives as a bandcamp album (https://kaiengel.bandcamp.com/album/idea) with no visible CC license tag on the album page; FMA sibling-album pages (Better_Way, Paradigm_Lost, Irsens_Tale) all deferred to per-track license pages and did not surface a catalog-level CC license. Cannot confirm the specific 'Idea' track is CC BY on an authoritative CC-tagged URL via WebFetch. Keep pending.

joshwoodward.com root is reachable but does not name a specific CC version. Verified specific track at https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Josh_Woodward/The_Simple_Life_Part_2_1667/JoshWoodward-TSL-NoVox-207-GoodToGo_1291 — page explicitly says 'licensed under Attribution License' linking to CC BY 4.0 legal code; duration 03:07 (187s), not 200s as recorded in manifest (delta 13s > 5s tolerance). Album page (The_Simple_Life_Part_2_1667) also confirmed 'CC BY 4.0' at album level. Updating url to the specific FMA track URL for reproducibility, updating duration_sec to 187.0, and keeping genre=pop (singer-songwriter instrumental).

Monplaisir artist landing page returned client_error (rate-limit). Verified the album page https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Monplaisir/Free_To_Use — page explicitly states 'The songs in this album are licensed under: CC0 1.0 Universal.' First track 'Free To Use 1' is 03:12 (192s) vs manifest 180s (delta 12s > 5s tolerance). Specifying track 'Free To Use 1' and updating url to album URL (which is where the WebFetch CC0 confirmation lives); the per-track FMA URL /free-to-use-1 returned client_error so is not used. Tolerance delta is documented; license is the gating criterion here (CC0).

Komiku artist landing page loaded but did not name a license (bio string 'Use it how you want' is not a formal license). Verified a specific Komiku album 'ULTRA PERSON VOL4' at https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Komiku/ULTRA_PERSON_VOL4 — page explicitly says 'The songs in this album are licensed under: CC0 1.0 Universal.' Picked 'Level 10 : Finally together' (03:07 / 187s) as the specific cheerful/upbeat pop track; manifest said 165s so delta is 22s > 5s, but license (CC0) is the gating criterion. Also sampled sibling track https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Komiku/Captain_Glouglous_Incredible_Week_Soundtrack/school which also confirmed CC0 1.0 Universal.

incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/music.html loads and names Kevin MacLeod but does not surface a specific CC version in the body (filter UI is JS-rendered). incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/licenses/ only says 'No charge. Requires that you credit the music' — consistent with CC BY but does not name the version. The incompetech License PDF and /wordpress/2014/10/the-new-license/ announcement URLs both returned client_error. Per hard rule, cannot flip to verified without a WebFetch-confirmable CC BY 4.0 (or 3.0) tag on the manifest URL. Keep pending.

audionautix.com root explicitly states: 'The music is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License' (link to CC BY 4.0 legal code). Manifest records 'CC BY 3.0' — version mismatch. Both are in allowed_licenses, so this is a metadata correction rather than a license rejection. However, title is still 'TBD Jason Shaw rock track' and the site's /index.php only shows 'Falling Sky' (house genre, 4:12), not a rock track. No specific rock track was observed via WebFetch in-session, so a specific-track pick cannot be verified yet. Flagging replace_recommended: upstream should (a) correct license to 'CC BY 4.0' and (b) select a specific Audionautix rock track and re-verify. Not flipping to verified without that specific-track confirmation.

Jamendo search page body is client-side rendered — WebFetch retrieves only meta tags + GTM, no track listings or license tags. Impossible to verify a license or pick a specific track from this URL via WebFetch alone. Row artist is also TBD, so there is no specific candidate to verify. Keep pending.
Same as row 6 — Jamendo search page is JS-only. Cannot verify license via WebFetch. Keep pending.

Lobo Loco artist page shows a 2025 album titled 'Christmas Market / CC-BY' but does not render per-track license tags; attempting the album page https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Lobo_Loco/Christmas_Market__CC-BY returned client_error. The artist is known to have a MIX of CC BY and CC BY-NC-SA, so flipping to verified without a specific CC BY track page confirmation would risk pulling in a CC BY-NC track. Keep pending; the specific track slug must be verified in a follow-up.

Jahzzar artist page did not name a catalog license. Verified at track URL https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Jahzzar/Tumbling_Dishes_Like_Old-Mans_Wishes/Step_On — explicitly 'Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 (CC BY-SA 4.0)', duration 03:01 (181s). Manifest said 180s — within ±5s tolerance. Updating url to the specific track URL, title to 'Step On', fma_id to 'jahzzar-tumbling-dishes-step-on', and duration_sec to 181.0.
Jazz-filtered incompetech page loads but shows 'No Track selected.' and no track list (filter widget is JS). Same license-surface issue as row 4. Keep pending.

usarmyband.com returned client_error — WebFetch could not retrieve the page. Cannot confirm 'US Government public domain' claim or any specific recording. Keep pending; may require a direct .gov/.mil access path from an unauthenticated proxy, or a replacement with a USAF/Navy band recording hosted somewhere WebFetch can reach.

Dexter Britain FMA page did not show a catalog-level license and directed to the artist's own site (dexterbritain.com/info/#creative-commons) for current terms. A sibling-album probe (freemusicarchive.org/music/Dexter_Britain/The_Tempest) returned client_error. The artist is known to have shifted some later releases to CC BY-NC, so flipping to verified without a specific CC BY-SA 3.0 track page confirmation is unsafe. Keep pending.

Podington Bear artist page loaded but surfaced no catalog-level license (only linked to an FMA 'License guide'). Artist catalog is known to mix CC BY-NC and CC BY-SA, so flipping to verified without a specific CC BY-SA track page is unsafe. Keep pending.

Not re-fetched in-session — incompetech's main music.html and filter variants (rows 4 and 10) surfaced no specific CC version via WebFetch, and incompetech's license announcement URLs returned client_error. Treating this row as identically blocked. Keep pending.
marineband.marines.mil returned client_error. Cannot confirm US Government public-domain status or any specific recording via WebFetch. Keep pending.
Jamendo search page is JS-only (same as rows 6, 7, 17). No listings or license tags visible via WebFetch. Row artist is TBD. Keep pending.
Same as rows 6, 7, 16 — Jamendo search is JS-only. Keep pending.

FMA Ambient genre page lists artist names (Anemoia, Jon Shuemaker, amholt, Joseph Sacco, Mark Lingard) but no per-track license tags render in the fetched body. Row artist is TBD. Cannot pick + verify a specific CC BY ambient track from the manifest URL alone. Keep pending.

fetch_notes: freemusicarchive.org returned client_error on several artist/album pages, but a sibling fetch minutes later succeeded — behavior is consistent with per-host rate limiting on WebFetch. Future verification runs should space FMA calls or run per-track retries with backoff.

jamendo.com search pages are client-side rendered; WebFetch cannot see track listings or license tags. Follow-up verification will need either a direct Jamendo API call or a specific-track URL (jamendo.com/track/<id>).

incompetech.com surfaces only the 'free with attribution' prose on its free-music pages. Kevin MacLeod rows (4, 10, 14) will need either an FMA mirror URL (where the license tag renders) or a direct quote from incompetech's licenses PDF.
usarmyband.com and marineband.marines.mil returned client_error; rows 11 and 15 will need a replacement from a WebFetch-reachable Public Domain source.

gate_status.reason: Only 4/20 rows verified against a WebFetch-reachable CC license page. 15 rows remain pending and 1 is replace_recommended. Flipping CHORD_EVAL_FETCH=1 now would download audio for rows whose license has not been confirmed on a reachable page, which violates the manifest's verification_protocol.
